1. Bring the milk to a gentle boil.
2. Stir in the oats and cook for 5 minutes, stirring.
3. Top with sliced banana. No added sugar.

1. Blend tomatoes, peppers and half the onion.
2. Fry the remaining onion in the oil, add the blend and cook for 15 minutes.
3. Add washed rice, seasoning and water to cover; cook covered on low heat until soft.
4. Serve with grilled or boiled chicken.
